verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a UI framework with SSR and serverless support, and its ecosystem could plausibly offer scheduled tasks, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only reactivity, rendering, SSR and tooling, with nothing on scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. Reactive effects that rerun on state changes are not time-based recurring schedules and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
